context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration 188 features verified working: (1) Per-site module overrides - GET/PUT /api/sites/{site_id}/modules returns site_overrides, org_modules, effective with proper org-resolved fallback; PUT with null or {clear:true} clears override; owner/manager/master-admin only. (2) Module guards - memberships and marketing routes return 403 when module disabled; master admin bypasses guards. (3) Creative Studio - POST /api/marketing/creative/generate accepts brand_lock, resolution_preset, custom_width/height; GET /api/marketing/creative/resolutions returns 11 presets. (4) AI Action Undo Log - GET /api/master-admin/assistant-actions returns rows + totals (by_type/by_mode/distinct_users/distinct_orgs) + undo_window_seconds=300; POST undo reverses resolve_issue (tested full flow). (5) Booking rules - GET/PUT/POST-reset /api/memberships/booking-rules round-trip correctly with inherited flag. (6) CSV bulk import - GET csv-template returns expected headers; POST bulk-import creates members, handles duplicates, validates required fields. (7) Module access resolution - GET /api/auth/me returns module_access:{operations,memberships,marketing}.
